children: (NYSE: BMY) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of sixty-three cents ($0.63) per share on the $0.10 par value common stock of the company.
The dividend is payable on November 2, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 2, 2026.
